meta.name: solidity-security
meta.description: Master smart contract security best practices to prevent common vulnerabilities and implement secure Solidity patterns. Use when writing smart contracts, auditing existing contracts, or implementing security measures for blockchain applications.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出防御常见漏洞的智能合约
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在编写或审计区块链合约,担心出现安全漏洞
copy.tagline_en: Write smart contracts that resist common security exploits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing or auditing blockchain contracts and worry about vulnerabilities

howto.what: Claude 会按安全模式编写 Solidity 智能合约,帮你排查重入、整数溢出、访问控制等漏洞,并产出 Hardhat 安全测试和供审计用的注释示例。
howto.when: 当你编写智能合约、审计已有合约,或为区块链应用加安全措施时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这份合约有没有重入漏洞
say.note: 会对照 CEI 等模式指出风险点

say.text: 写段测试,验证重入攻击会被拦下
say.note: 给出 Hardhat + Chai 测试样例

say.text: 给这份合约补上审计用的 NatSpec 注释

howto.what_en: Claude writes Solidity contracts with secure patterns, checks for reentrancy, integer overflow and access-control flaws, and produces Hardhat security tests plus audit-ready NatSpec comments.
howto.when_en: Use when writing smart contracts, auditing existing contracts, or adding security measures to blockchain applications.

say_en.text: Check this contract for reentrancy vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Flags risk points against patterns like CEI.

say_en.text: Write a test proving the reentrancy attack reverts.
say_en.note: Returns a Hardhat + Chai test example.

say_en.text: Add audit-ready NatSpec comments to this contract.
